title: FTI Touristik / Meeting Point professional, corporate, authority and proceeding caret census
scope: Finite role-selected snapshot of the FTI/Meeting Point people, legal persons or controlled perimeters, advisers, lawyers, insolvency office-holders, institutions/sub-organs and formal proceedings/files appearing in the thirteen controlled core, specialist and release-candidate surfaces listed below. Eligibility is limited to the Germany-Spain-EU custody, insolvency, restructuring, public-credit, transaction and alertador chain and its expressly connected CAM/RICPE/Concurso 36 predecessor layer. This 101-object denominator excludes the canonical asset-transaction register and watch view added after the snapshot and does not purport to enumerate hotel-by-hotel assets, new buyers, operators, managers, financiers, other new counterparties or unrelated local parties. It does not follow links into deeper page bodies.
scope_rule: Caret confirms reconciled identity only. It never confirms a role on a date, representation, mandate, receipt, knowledge, intent, conflict, concealment, causation, use of funds, loss, liability, offence, standing, competence or outcome.
snapshot_note: The hashes freeze the thirteen-surface audit snapshot. S08-S10 also attest the exact current integrated ES/EN/DE continuity-page bytes and are enforced by the focused validator. A later page revision requires recomputing those three fingerprints and rerunning the validator; it does not expand this role-selected denominator.
exclusions: Documents, court orders, contracts, statutes, dates, amounts, links, websites, platforms and generic unnamed roles are not identities.
A conditional future submission route is not counted as a proceeding until a file or registration exists.
Private recipients and native-message identifiers are excluded unless the same identity is already named in a controlled public-safe source surface.
Publishers and travel-distribution brands are included only where a core surface treats them as a custody, contracting or identity-resolution object.
The census does not include the canonical asset-transaction register or watch view added after this snapshot and does not follow links from the thirteen controlled surfaces into deeper page bodies.
Hotel-by-hotel assets and buyers, operators, managers, financiers or other counterparties first appearing outside the thirteen controlled surfaces are outside this finite denominator.
collision_guards: FTI Touristik controlled perimeter is not FTI Touristik GmbH, FTI Group Governance & Compliance, the broad FTI compliance perimeter or FTI Consulting.
Meeting Point Hotels commercial perimeter is not Meeting Point International GmbH, Meeting Point Hotelmanagement Holding GmbH or any of the three Spanish debtors.
Meeting Point Hotelmanagement (Canaries), S.L.U., Meeting Point Spain, S.L.U. and Meeting Point Investment, S.L.U. are three distinct Spanish debtors.
FINKENHOF procedural counsel is not MHBK, an insolvency administrator, or the Rödl Spanish-review route.
Axel W. Bierbach and Oliver Schartl are distinct people and debtor-specific appointments must not transfer between proceedings.
Rödl & Partner Abogados y Asesores Tributarios S.L.P. is not a generic Rödl label, FINKENHOF, MHBK or Auren.
Generic Auren professional perimeter is not AUREN REESTRUCTURACIONES SLP.
SEPI is not FASEE; FASEE is not a debtor or a loan instrument.
BLUESEA commercial perimeter is not Gestora Blue Sea Partner, S.A.; neither is Portobello Capital, S.L.
RIC statutory mechanism is not RIC Private Equity Investment Partners SCR, S.A.; RICPE is not the RICPE/HNT/MYND project layer.
Ithikios/provider identity is not RICPE or the RICPE internal information-system responsible person or sub-organ.
PwC Canarias, RSM Spain, Grant Thornton, A&G and historical San Telmo are distinct professional perimeters.
Club Sei and Labranda are commercial/brand objects, not automatically legal persons or contracting entities.
A registry attribution to Alberto López Villarrubia does not establish signature, assignment, substitution, knowledge, conflict or a personal disclosure duty.
The source literal José D. Acosta Matos does not by itself transfer the caret of José Daniel Acosta Matos without full-name reconciliation.
A general Ministerio Fiscal or TSJC identity does not resolve the exact competent Fiscalía, prosecutor, chamber or receiving unit.
Registration, receipt and transmission are not opening, joinder, preservation, review or substantive determination.
verdict: FINITE ROLE-SELECTED 13-SURFACE PROFESSIONAL-INSTITUTIONAL CENSUS COMPLETE; 40/101 CARET_CONFIRMED; 61 CARET_PENDING; 0 CARET_SUSPENDED; PARTIAL — NOT ALL IS^
